description: a sound effect, ambience or music cue

bars.description: music only: loop length in bars

engine.description: the audio engine; the kind's default if left out

family.description: the still family that makes it; the project's default if left out

for.description: foley only: the sprite asset whose animation it scores

name.description: the asset's name: lowercase letters, digits, - and _

notes.description: anything a person or agent should know; never changes what is made

pivot.description: the anchor, as a fraction of the frame [x, y]; feet-centre if left out

post.description: post-steps in order; the render mode's chain if left empty

prompt.description: what to make, in plain words; the style clause is added after it

references.description: pictures this asset is made from, by name (project files or ComfyUI input/)

seconds.description: length; the sound kind's default if left out

seed.description: fixed seed; derived from the project seed and the name if left out

size.description: the master's size in pixels, [width, height]; the kind's default if left out

sound.description: what kind of sound, which sets its defaults

title: forge sound
